releaseNotes:
- fix(proxy): models that cap images per request (Wally/RunAnywhere `glm-5.3-flash`, 8 max) no longer fail with 400 — the excess is trimmed oldest-first and the request retried, so the newest turn keeps its images
- fix(proxy): custom OpenAI-compatible nodes no longer fail on rejected parameters — paramfix applies on the chat forward path, a provider-prefix rule drops `store` for every `openai-compatible-*` node, and unknown parameters are repaired from the upstream error and retried
